mechanism: Amphetamine increases sympathomimetic activity (heart rate, blood pressure) which may be exacerbated in HIV patients with underlying cardiovascular compromise; raltegravir has no direct pharmacokinetic interaction but combined CNS stimulation and potential for increased cardiovascular stress exists.
action: Monitor cardiovascular parameters closely; consider baseline ECG and regular vital sign assessment; counsel on amphetamine abuse potential and cardiovascular warning signs; alternative ADHD agents may be safer.
